goal: Build and verify the first native macOS 26 Praxodoro vertical slice with a complete offline ADHD-aware focus loop, Liquid Instrument accessibility paths, and explicit Lite/Pro/Enterprise capability boundaries.
criteriaMappingMeaning: Each atom's criteria list identifies requirements it supports; it does not claim final acceptance. Final acceptance requires atom 8.2 evidence mapping against the complete current tree.

atoms.title: Pin XcodeGen and scaffold the native project plus internal package
atoms.red: scripts/verify-scaffold.sh fails on missing project.yml, project, or targets
atoms.green: scaffold check, swift test, unsigned xcodebuild, and isolated launch pass

atoms.title: Add strict concurrency, formatting, provenance, and regeneration gates
atoms.red: project regeneration/provenance verifier fails before gates exist
atoms.green: generator produces no diff and quality settings/build are clean

atoms.title: Implement product capability registry and edition matrices
atoms.red: ProductRulesTests fail to compile on missing capability types
atoms.green: edition matrix and registry completeness tests pass

atoms.title: Implement entitlement evidence, policy precedence, expiry, and downgrade
atoms.red: EntitlementSnapshotTests fail on missing evidence and policy APIs
atoms.green: verified, expired, unverified, managed, and downgrade fixtures pass

atoms.title: Define session states, intents, events, projections, and timing presets
atoms.red: SessionModelTests fail on missing domain types and presets
atoms.green: all lifecycle states encode/decode and four Lite presets validate

atoms.title: Implement exhaustive pure focus and coach reducer
atoms.red: transition tests fail on missing reducer and rejection contract
atoms.green: complete state-intent matrix and full focus-loop fixture pass

atoms.title: Implement canonical time projection and reconciliation
atoms.red: TimerReconciliationTests fail on missing clock and reconciliation APIs
atoms.green: pause, sleep, wake, relaunch, DST, wall-change, Flow, and exactly-once fixtures pass

atoms.title: Implement actor engine and in-memory atomic repository
atoms.red: SessionEngineTests fail on missing snapshot stream and commit contract
atoms.green: concurrency, revision, atomicity, and effect-failure tests pass

atoms.title: Implement SwiftData V1 schema and repository adapter
atoms.red: repository contract fails on missing SwiftData schema/adapter
atoms.green: in-memory and temporary SwiftData contracts plus recovery fixtures pass

atoms.title: Implement Liquid Instrument tokens, surface roles, and render policy
atoms.red: RenderPolicyTests fail on missing role/fallback mappings
atoms.green: all accessibility, appearance, power, and hidden policies pass without external effects dependency

atoms.title: Wire shared app container, main window, and menu bar
atoms.red: AppModelTests fail on missing shared engine and independent session/capability subscriptions
atoms.green: main/menu-bar parity, shared revision, and capability-only publication tests pass

atoms.title: Build accessible Initiate and Focus surfaces
atoms.red: UI/model tests fail for offline start, capacity, editing, controls, and keyboard flow
atoms.green: initiate/focus tests, build, relaunch, and keyboard smoke pass

atoms.title: Build check-in, detour, break, re-entry, and review surfaces
atoms.red: coach-loop tests fail on missing semantics, transitions, restoration, and sparse-review guard
atoms.green: full keyboard/VoiceOver-identified focus loop passes without punitive or commerce behavior

atoms.title: Add optional compact floating surface
atoms.red: compact tests fail on missing panel activation, accessibility, and state parity
atoms.green: Spaces/fullscreen/focus/VoiceOver/disable parity smoke passes

atoms.title: Implement data dictionary, retention, and session-only coach defaults
atoms.red: retention tests fail on missing category and cleanup policy
atoms.green: boundary fixtures and data-dictionary parity pass

atoms.title: Implement privacy-safe local notifications
atoms.red: scheduler tests fail on missing opt-in, preview, dedupe, and denial behavior
atoms.green: permission, privacy, event, cancellation, and timer-fallback fixtures pass

atoms.title: Implement exact local export and honest Delete All
atoms.red: export/delete tests fail on missing category selection, downgrade reads, and complete cleanup
atoms.green: Lite-after-Pro reads, minimal/all exports, full local deletion, and partial-failure messaging pass

atoms.title: Complete native accessibility and visual regression matrix
atoms.red: accessibility suite captures any unreachable, unlabeled, chatty, clipped, or missing fallback
atoms.green: keyboard, VoiceOver, effects, contrast, large-text, light/dark, and screenshot dossier pass

atoms.title: Prove zero-network, no-surveillance, energy, and hidden-scene behavior
atoms.red: privacy-performance verifier fails when evidence capture is absent
atoms.green: network, entitlement, log, write, hidden-renderer, and energy checks pass

atoms.title: Add macOS CI and one local verification entry point
atoms.red: scripts/verify.sh fails each unwired mandatory stage
atoms.green: local verification and macOS CI cover spec, format, tests, build, secret, privacy, and smoke

atoms.title: Complete fresh-context validation, reviews, docs, and archive readiness
atoms.red: validator finds any unmapped criterion, stale state, unexplained anomaly, or open Major/Important finding
atoms.green: full verification, independent validator, specialist reviews, final smoke, and OpenSpec task status pass
